questions: Are there any other unusual movements or stiffness in your body besides the left arm shaking?
Did the shaking start on its own, or did it begin after an illness, injury, or starting a new medication?
Does the shaking in your left arm happen mostly when you are trying to do something with your hand, or does it also bother you when your arm is completely relaxed?
Have you noticed any change in your handwriting, such as it becoming smaller or more cramped?
Do you feel unsteady or have difficulty with your balance when walking?
Have you noticed a reduced sense of smell?
Has anyone in your family had similar shaking or a disease like Parkinson's?
Are you taking any new medications or supplements, including over-the-counter drugs?
